items.title: Garrett Wilson: Season-worst performance in Week 7
items.text:
Wilson caught two of three targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Aggravates previous knee injury
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Jones aggravated a previous knee injury during Sunday's 16-10 win against the Colts, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Two long catches and TD in Week 7
items.text:
Cooper caught all five of his targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

items.title: Ollie Gordon: Stretches TD streak to four games
items.text:
Gordon rushed 25 times for 103 yards and a touchdown while catching one of three targets for no gain in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Tops 100 rushing yards in Week 7
items.text:
Allen rushed 17 times for 104 yards and caught six of seven targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
